reason: 该插件的主要用户功能是为 DeepSeek Harness 自动注入一段歧义处理规则到 system prompt（名称 `ambiguity-handling`，顺序 `50`），并在请求模糊时要求模型先给出多个可能理解与“其他”选项后再继续。证据来自 README 中对 `inject = ['systemPrompt']` 与 `ctx.systemPrompt.section` 的说明，以及包清单中对 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 bundle 配置。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 会话系统提示词追加歧义处理规则，让模型在需求不清时先给出多种理解并请求用户确认。
summaries.en: This plugin adds ambiguity-handling instructions to the DeepSeek Harness system prompt so the model asks for clarification when requests are unclear, offering multiple interpretations before proceeding.

capabilities: Injects an `ambiguity-handling` section into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt via the `systemPrompt` extension point.
Instructs the model to ask for clarification by listing 2-4 possible interpretations plus an "other" option when input appears ambiguous.
Uses DSH bundle/patch configuration (`cordis.patch.yml` + `dsh.bundle`) for profile-based activation and removal.
